disclosure: This is a simulated verification call for a fictional product. An automated check helps us see whether we explained the terms clearly. It cannot prove understanding or certify legal consent.

clauses.title: Monthly payment
clauses.explain: In this fictional plan, you pay 1,000 rupees every month for 3 years. This is not a one-time payment.
clauses.question: To check whether I explained clearly: how much must you pay, how often, and for how long?
clauses.fallback_explain: You pay 1,000 rupees each month for 36 months, which is 3 years. Paying 1,000 rupees just once is not enough.
misconceptions: Only one payment of 1,000 rupees is required

clauses.title: Early withdrawal
clauses.explain: The lock-in lasts 3 years. If you withdraw before then, a penalty of 5 percent of the withdrawal amount applies.
clauses.question: What happens if you need to withdraw in the second year? How long is the lock-in?
clauses.fallback_explain: Withdrawing before 3 years costs 5 percent of the amount withdrawn. For example, withdrawing 10,000 rupees costs a 500 rupee penalty.
must_have_facts: Withdrawal before 3 years incurs a 5 percent penalty on the withdrawal amount
misconceptions: The penalty is always a fixed 500 rupees regardless of the amount

clauses.title: Returns are uncertain
clauses.explain: Returns on this fictional plan are not guaranteed. The value changes with the market and you can lose money.
clauses.question: If the market falls, is your profit fixed? Please explain in your own words.
clauses.fallback_explain: There is no promise of a fixed profit. If the market falls, your investment value can fall and you can suffer a loss.
must_have_facts: Investment value can fall and a loss is possible
misconceptions: There is no possibility of losing money

clauses.title: Cancellation window
clauses.explain: This is an invented demo rule: you can request cancellation within 15 days of receiving the documents. A fixed 100 rupee processing charge is deducted from the refund.
clauses.question: If you want to cancel 10 days after receiving the documents, what can you do and what is the charge? Please also state the deadline.
clauses.fallback_explain: You can request cancellation within 15 days after receiving the documents. A fixed 100 rupee processing charge is deducted from your refund. This is only an invented demo rule.
must_have_facts: Can request cancellation within 15 days of receiving documents
A fixed 100 rupee processing charge is deducted from the refund
misconceptions: The cancellation window starts from an event other than receiving documents
This cancellation window allows cancellation at any time

messages.understood: Thank you, you explained that point. Let us move to the next one.
messages.partial: You explained some of the points. Let me clarify the remaining details.
messages.misunderstood: My explanation may not have been clear. Let me explain the terms again.
messages.no_evidence: Saying yes alone does not show me what you understood. Please explain in your own words.
messages.human_review: I am stopping this verification. A team member needs to review this with you. Consent has not been accepted.
messages.complete: Thank you. You completed all the demo teach-back checks. This fictional demonstration is not a legal consent certificate.
